next_step_notes:
7/13

No update, plan to follow up directly with CHRO on 7/14. Goal is to propose in-office sync as they are based in ATL

7/3

Slow moving account, positive feedback from CHRO presentation, but will still likely require a pilot. Continuing to follow up, we are competing for bandwidth with several priorities.

6/13

Presented to CHRO earlier this week, he is open to an additional discussion to scope a POC and align on ROI metrics

6/9

Sync with primary stakeholder scheduled for 6/10 prior to CHRO meeting which is on 6/11.

The goal is to secure CHRO buy-in for a POC and scope a full partnership.

6/2

Working with primary stakeholder to coordinate CHRO call the week of 6/9

5/19

Call scheduled with primary stakeholder on 5/28 to discuss pilot logistics and bring in broader stakeholder group to align on highest priority use cases of a potential pilot.

5/2

NTG is exploring Wisq to reduce the manual workload on a lean HR team by automating HR service delivery and scaling support across their 1,500 employees. Christie McNeill (Director of People Solutions) is the primary stakeholder and is driving the evaluation. She’s aligned on the value but has budget constraints, so we are discussing a $25K paid pilot focused on low-lift, high-impact use cases—starting with Benefits and Knowledge Management. NTG has internal data scientists, but Christie acknowledged that building internally would be barebones and high risk due to limited HR domain expertise. 

Next step 

 Working session with additional HR stakeholders (e.g. Benefits, HRBPs, Talent Development) to validate use cases, define pilot scope, and pre-align on success criteria and potential full partnership (~$100K).






4/28

Next step - meeting on 5/1

Broaden Discovery:
Suggest a working session with Christie and additional NTG stakeholders (Comp, Benefits, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Talent Development) to deeply understand their unique challenges, workflows, and high-impact opportunities.

Avoid a Pilot if Possible:
Christie insinuated that her definition of "pilot" would be a small, paid, limited-user rollout to validate functionality before committing.
Instead of defaulting into a pilot, your goal is to uncover the real concerns driving this desire (e.g., risk, cost, adoption fears) and determine what NTG would need to feel confident in a full partnership — without a formal pilot.

Clarify Evaluation and Success Criteria:
Dig into what NTG would need to see in terms of functionality, value, user adoption, and ROI to greenlight a full rollout confidently.

4/23

Completed 2nd call with Director of People Solutions. Very interested in the platform and there's clear need, but she had pushback about pricing, and also asked about some type of pilot. Call scheduled 5/1 to discuss options. Need to involve more senior stakeholders and align on timing.


AM 4/21: call rescheduled for 4/22
Discussing key use cases, didn't get all the way through intro deck last time. Discover priority use cases on 4/22 call. Expand DMU.
